svg.title: Omega Stability · kitesurfing an unstable equilibrium
svg.desc: Three exponential layers are exactly undone by three logarithms for real c greater than one and valid intermediate arguments. A separate illustrative linearized model of the prime-layer composition with derivative approximately 1.007355142 at the Omega constant shows a small perturbation increasing away from equilibrium; the rider and kite tilt as it grows. The loop resets for replay, not because the fixed point attracts.

g.text: Three layers up. Three logarithms down.
Real c > 1 · all intermediate logs defined.
EXACT INVERSE · SEPARATE LOCAL INSTABILITY · REPLAY RESETS THE ILLUSTRATION
